title: Unlocking the secrets to Facebook ads? It's not just throwing things ...
description: Unlocking the secrets to Facebook ads? It's not just throwing things at the wall and hoping they stick! Want ads that actually work? Check it out! #brandmarketing #facebookads #marketingtips #socialmediamarketing
transcript: And I'm showing you this process so that you understand that making Facebook ads work isn't as simple as let's just go in and create a campaign, try and do some targeting and put some copy and create it together and just hopefully it will work. There is a process behind this. This is exactly what I built into my framework which is called the brand driven performance marketing. And the reason it's called that is everything we're doing here is considered brand marketing. Who am I targeting? How can I get them get the communication across? What's the messaging? What's the creative? That's all brand targeting 101 performance targeting is this little thing here click through rate conversion rate micro conversions and bounce rates and analysis that I fear is where a lot of people end up focusing too much. So you launch your ads, start looking at the numbers and hope that the numbers tell you what to do. It will tell you where things are going wrong. It won't really aid you in what to do because unless you've got this structure you won't know.
